items.title: Pakistan withdraw from World Championship of Legends after PCB refuse NOCs
items.summary: This year's tournament began on 3 October, but Pakistan's game against Bangladesh was postponed

items.title: Batting bust, bowling boost as Tigers draw UAE practice match
items.summary: Bangladesh’s batting suffered a collpase as they were bundled out for a paltry 234 in their first innings, but a strong response from the bowlers saw their two-day practice match against the UAE end in an expected draw at the ICC Academy in Dubai on Monday.

items.title: Bangladesh can now dominate in Test cricket: Hasan Mahmud
items.summary: "If we win four matches at home, why shouldn't we play in the World Test Championship final? That's the dream for Bangladesh now," Hasan said.

items.title: Bigger contingent, smaller return
items.summary: Bangladesh’s contingent keeps getting bigger at the Asian Games, but the results have gone in the opposite direction.

items.title: Shanto awaits green light for Afghanistan Test
items.summary: Bangladesh are still waiting on Test captain Najmul Hossain Shanto’s availability for the one-off Test against Afghanistan, starting on October 9 in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Bangladesh bundled out for 234 after 108-run opening stand in UAE practice match
items.summary: Soumya retired after scoring 57 off 92 balls, hitting six fours and a six, while Mominul Haque contributed 33.

items.title: Joy shines with ton as Chattogram dominate Rajshahi on Day 2
items.summary: Chattogram Division's Mahmudul Hasan Joy scored the first century of the National Cricket League season on Sunday, putting his side in a strong position against Rajshahi Division on Day 2 at Chattogram's Bir Sreshtho Flight Lieutenant Matiur Rahman Stadium.

items.title: Empty-handed, under fire after historic failure
items.summary: Bangladesh had never left an Asian Games cricket tournament without a medal. Until Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

items.title: Ratnayake puts in all-round shift to lead Sri Lanka to bronze medal
items.summary: Bangladesh collapsed with the bat after Tharindu Ratnayake had smashed 65 in 32 balls to take Sri Lanka to a solid 165 for 9

items.title: Malibongwe Maketa named Bangladesh men's assistant coach
items.summary: Cricinfo has learned that Maketa has been hired with BCB's focus on the two South Africa tours in the next 12 months

items.title: Bronze at stake as Bangladesh, SL look to bring cheer to Asian Games contingents
items.summary: Bangladesh start as favourites against a decidedly second-string Sri Lanka side

items.title: Uncapped Biswas, Habiba in Nigar Sultana-led Bangladesh squad for Australia ODIs
items.summary: Nigar had stepped down from T20I captaincy after the Asian Games but the board remains confident in her leadership abilities

items.title: Bangladesh and Pakistan hope the sun keeps rising in Nisshin
items.summary: The forecast for semi-finals day in Nisshin is excellent; if that changes and there is no play, Pakistan will enter the final by virtue of their higher seeding

items.title: Molineux, Hamilton out of Bangladesh ODIs; McGrath to captain
items.summary: Molineux is battling a hip injury while Hamilton has a minor quad strain with both hoping to be fit for the New Zealand T20Is
